name: GHT transferFrom moves tokens without an allowance
summary: The GHT implementation installed 13 hours before the exploit let any caller transferFrom any holder without an allowance. The attacker moved the WETH/GHT Uniswap V2 pair's entire GHT balance to the token contract, called sync() to set the GHT reserve to 1 wei, moved the GHT back into the pair, and swapped it for the pair's 15.44 WETH; a copycat repeated it four blocks later for 0.2 WETH.
notes: The implementation is unverified; the missing allowance check is shown by the traces, where contracts the pair never approved (a Uniswap V2 pair cannot approve) moved its balance. The proxy's only earlier implementation ran for about 7,500 blocks with no transferFrom by an unapproved caller, and the owner paused the token 121 blocks after the anchor.
Loss is the pair's WETH; GHT has no price and returned to the pair.
